name: cortese-expertenwebseite
description: Persönliche Expertenwebseite Alessandro Cortese – Tiefbau, Netzinfrastruktur und KI

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && pagefind --site dist/client
scripts.test:varianten: PUBLIC_CONTACT_FORM=true SHOW_DRAFTS=true astro build && pagefind --site dist/client && playwright test -c playwright.varianten.config.ts; npm run build:fast
scripts.test:alle: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:varianten
scripts.build:pages: DEPLOY_ZIEL=github-pages astro build && pagefind --site dist && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.test:pages: npm run build:pages && playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.ts
scripts.build:swizzonic: DEPLOY_ZIEL=swizzonic astro build && pagefind --site dist && cp deploy/swizzonic/.htaccess dist/.htaccess && cp deploy/swizzonic/_astro/.htaccess dist/_astro/.htaccess
scripts.test:swizzonic: npm run build:swizzonic && playwright test -c playwright.swizzonic.config.ts
